RWA Watch — oracle health check for tokenised real-world assets
==============================================================

What this service does
----------------------
RWA Watch tracks five tokenised real-world assets (SPY, NVDA, TSLA, GOLD, QQQ) every ~30 minutes.
It compares the volume-weighted median price of on-chain tokens against the Chainlink price feed on
Arbitrum One, and raises alerts when the gap exceeds per-asset thresholds.

The /api/check endpoint
-----------------------
Base URL: https://rwa-watch.netlify.app/api/check

  GET /api/check             — returns an array of five asset objects
  GET /api/check?asset=NVDA  — returns a single object for NVDA
  GET /api/check?asset=GOLD  — etc. (SPY, NVDA, TSLA, GOLD, QQQ)

Unknown asset → HTTP 400 with the list of valid assets.
Headers: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, Cache-Control: public, max-age=60

How to read the verdict
-----------------------
The top-level "verdict" field is the signal to act on.

  OK            — gap within normal bounds; oracle price can be trusted.
  CAUTION       — gap above half the alert threshold; treat the oracle with care.
  DO_NOT_TRUST  — gap at or above the alert threshold, or an active alert is open.
  NO_ORACLE     — no Chainlink feed for this asset on Arbitrum (always QQQ).
  UNKNOWN       — our data is more than 35 minutes old; we cannot give a verdict.

The "reason" field is a plain-English sentence explaining the verdict.

Thresholds (% gap that triggers DO_NOT_TRUST)
---------------------------------------------
  SPY / NVDA / TSLA : 2.0% market open,  3.0% market closed
  GOLD              : 1.5% always
  QQQ               : no oracle (NO_ORACLE)

CAUTION fires at half the trigger threshold. Market state is in market.state.

Recommended agent workflow
--------------------------
1. Call GET /api/check?asset=<ASSET>
2. Read verdict. If OK → proceed. If CAUTION → note it. If DO_NOT_TRUST or UNKNOWN → halt
   any price-sensitive action and surface the reason to the user.
3. The gap_pct field gives the raw divergence (token median vs Chainlink, positive = tokens above).
4. alert_open: true means a divergence alert is currently open in the database.
5. data_as_of is the ISO timestamp of our latest poll; oracle.updated_at is the last Chainlink update.

Example call
------------
  curl https://rwa-watch.netlify.app/api/check?asset=NVDA

Example response (truncated)
-----------------------------
  {
    "asset": "NVDA",
    "verdict": "OK",
    "reason": "Gap of -0.21% is within normal bounds (market closed, threshold 3%).",
    "market": { "state": "closed" },
    "oracle": { "source": "Chainlink", "network": "Arbitrum One",
                "feed_address": "0x4881A4418b5F2460B21d6F08CD5aA0678a7f262F",
                "price": 143.52, "age_minutes": 12 },
    "tokens": { "median_price": 143.22, "tokens_used": 4, "volume_24h_usd": 2341800 },
    "gap_pct": -0.2091,
    "alert_open": false,
    "data_as_of": "2026-11-24T12:47:38.142+00:00"
  }

OpenAPI spec: https://rwa-watch.netlify.app/openapi.json
